The Tschuggen Grand Hotel in Arosa is a 5-star superior luxury hotel in the Bündner Bergen located at 1'800m. As one of the four hotels in the "The Tschuggen Collection", our hotel offers 128 individually designed rooms, suites and mountain lofts, plus four stylish restaurants - including the 19-point gourmet highlight La Brezza Gault Millau & two Michelin stars - and an impressive 5 000 m2 spa mountain oasis, designed by Mario Botta. OUR VISION - We return your value to time. Are you a passionate and empathetic host, appreciative & respectful? Then you are right with us. Entrance at 25. November 2026 Employment limited to the end of March 2027 |
• Professional experience in a comparable position or in the area of guest service, winter sports or hotel industry
• Enthusiasm for winter sports as well as very good knowledge of the ski area
• Professional experience in 5* houses desired
• Fluent German and English skills are a prerequisite, every other language is an advantage
• Team-ready, responsible and flexible
• Careful appearance and professional manners
• Empathetic and discreet personality and service-oriented appearance
• Category B driving licence Duty |
• Professional care of our guests around the topic of skiing and winter sports
• Organization and support of the ski-in & ski-out service
• Transport and provision of ski, snowboard and winter equipment
• Coordination and cooperation with our hotel-internal sports business Gisler Sport as well as external ski rentals
• Support for the organisation of ski school reservations, ski passes and other winter activities
• Assisting our guests in putting on and removing the ski equipment
• Daily quality control of ski depots as well as ensuring order and cleanliness
• Assistance with luggage service as well as arrival and departure of guests
